Self-aware staleness guard (compound_survivors_voided()): refuses to test against a stale ablation leaf manifest rather than reporting a false pass. Re-ablating the manifest un-skips it; this is not a coverage gap.

test_windows_case_variants_are_the_same_repository is gated `@pytest.mark.skipif(os.name != "nt", ...)` -- it asserts a Windows drive-letter path (C:\... vs c:\...) normalizes identically, which is not a meaningful assertion on Linux's posix os.name. This test runs for real on every local Windows session (the repo's own primary dev environment) and would run on CI too if CI ever used a windows-latest runner; ubuntu-latest simply has no Windows path form to test.

covered_elsewhere: test_negative_control_pre_fix_had_no_repository_resolution searches full git history (`git log -S ... `) for the commit that introduced resolve_target_repo. GitHub Actions' actions/checkout defaults to a shallow clone (fetch-depth: 1), so that commit is genuinely absent from CI's history -- the test correctly self-detects this and skips rather than fabricating a pass/fail on a control it cannot actually evaluate. Runs for real, and proves the control, against any full clone (including this repo's own local checkouts, which are never shallow).
